title: BADF demand record
description: badf/demands/<id>.json. The in-tree, digest-bound record of the demand that authorizes a work package. The GitHub Issue (or a target project's own token) is the SOURCE; this record is what the gate can verify offline. A demand is where authority enters: authorized_by must be a human. Agents may DISCOVER (kind=discovery) but may not authorize.

demand_id.description: Allocated sequentially by BADF: the next unused number. It never encodes the source Issue number (PRs and Issues share one number space); source.issue carries that.

kind.description: issue: exported from a GitHub Issue, body digest-bound. token: a [WP-NNNN]-style admission token in a repository with no Issue space. decision: an operator decision with no Issue (RECONSTRUCTED). discovery: found by BADF itself -- the only kind with no human authorizer; the human gate is then the merge.

source.description: The single repository this demand authorizes work on. A work package whose repository differs is refused, not reinterpreted.

authorized_by.description: Required for every kind except discovery, and must be a human principal: a demand is where authority enters. An agent cannot manufacture one, and re-signing the lockfile does not change that.

provenance.description: How this record was produced, distinct from kind: EXPORTED_FROM_SOURCE (verbatim from the source, digest-bound), RECONSTRUCTED (written after the fact from a decision that preceded the doctrine), DISCOVERED (BADF found it).

learning.description: Institutional learning from a concluded demand (BADF-WP-0035): a docs/learnings/<slug>.md path or the literal NONE_DECLARED. Required by the gate when status is RESOLVED or REJECTED -- silence is not 'nothing learned'.
